chunks: Then We roused them to ascertain which of the two groups could account for the period they had stayed.
ai.seo_question: Why did Allah cause the People of the Cave to wake up according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Tajassus* (divine testing) to validate the truth of the Resurrection (*Ma'ad*) through empirical verification by the sleepers themselves. It highlights the miraculous preservation of their bodies and minds, serving as a sign for their contemporaries and future generations regarding the power of Allah to restore life after death.
